title: common (schema v1 skeleton)
description: Shared definitions. Source: devteam #13 draft (common.schema.json) + 02 §2 rule 3 (u64 as decimal string). TODO(schema-v1): $id host is a placeholder.

U64Str.description: u64 as decimal string (TypeScript number is 53-bit). Only for Web-reachable u64 IDs / revisions (OSM / Valhalla derived ids, trip_revision, route_revision). docs v1.2 02 §2.1, 04 §2.

MonoMs.description: Monotonic ms (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime basis) as a JSON integer (number), not a decimal string. Rust never reads a clock. docs v1.2 ADR-0008 decision 2, 04 §2.

UnixS.description: UNIX seconds (wall clock). Kept separate from MonoMs (time-kind separation, checklist #8).

Evidence.description: Evidence<T> (04 §2), flattened and tagged by kind: confirmed {value, source_ref, observed_at?} | inferred {value, rule_id, source_refs[]} | unknown {reason}. Each kind takes only its own fields. value type is constrained by the referencing schema. TODO(schema-v1): observed_at type is not defined in 04 §2 (left unconstrained).

ErrorCode.description: dc_core error codes (devteam #40 + E_FORBIDDEN_WHILE_DRIVING for plan-candidate dc_route_commit while driving, 02 §2.1 #9; distinct from L3 RejectCode FORBIDDEN_WHILE_DRIVING). E_UNIMPLEMENTED is a skeleton-only placeholder, TODO(abi-v1): remove before ABI freeze.
